Long Blade is a combat specialization skill in . This skill determines the effectiveness when using weapons of this type. Long Blade is governed by the Strength attribute. There are two primary types of weapons governed by this skill: one-handed (e.g. longswords) and two-handed (e.g. claymores). One-handed weapons are generally lighter and faster, and do less damage, but allow the use of a shield granting greater protection. Two-handed are generally heavier and slower, and do more damage, but prevent the use of a shield thereby sacrificing protection. It is similar to the skills of Blade (), and One-Handed (). As the skill level increase, so will the accuracy and damage of each strike. A success strike during combat will increase the skill progression a percentage. When the progression of the current skill level reaches 100%, the skill level increases by 1.

The Lord's Mail, also known as the Armor of Morihaus or the gift of Kynareth, is an ancient cuirass of unsurpassable quality. It grants the wearer the power to absorb health, resist the effects of spells, and cures the wearer of poison when used. It is said that whenever Kynareth deems the wearer unworthy, the Lord's Mail will be taken away and hidden for the next chosen one. The deserter Furius Acilius is suspected in its disappearance, and is thought to hide in the Underground Caves near Ebonheart.

Luciana Galena is a fence in the Thieves Guild. She is also an Expert trainer in Light Armor. She can, rarely, be found in her home, which is located above the house for sale in Bravil. To get to her house, head south in Bravil and over the bridge towards The Archer's Paradox. Next door and upstairs to the Archer's Paradox is Luciana Galenas House (picking her lock may be required). She wakes at 8 AM, and heads to The Lonely Suitor Lodge across the street at noon, where she works until 2 AM. On Sundas, she goes to the chapel upon awaking, then the lodge as usual.

Madness Ore is a material that is used to make madness armor and weapons in the . According to Cutter, it contains the souls of dead heroes. It can be found on grummites or in madness ore deposits that are mainly found underground in the ruined forts of the Shivering Isles. Deposits do not respawn their ore content.

Madness Armor is one of the sets of armor added with expansion. It is a set of heavy armor. It is forged from madness ore, which can be found in deposits in ruins on the Shivering Isles or as loot from dead Grummites.

Madness Weapons are one of the two new weapon sets in expansion. For these weapons, the hero must collect madness ore and give it to the craftsman in Cutter's Weapons in Crucible, who can make madness armor or weapons at the Hero's request. If the Hero wishes the weapon to be enchanted, they must also collect the proper matrices for each item. When the Hero makes an enchanted item, the matrix for it will be removed from the inventory.

A Madness Helmet can be forged from madness ore by the smith Cutter, who operates Cutter's Weapons in Crucible. She can forge one helmet from two pieces of madness ore. Providing a Madness Helmet Matrix will cause the helmet to be enchanted, as well. The quality of the helmet and, if applicable, its enchantment is scaled to the Hero's level at the time when asking Cutter to make it.

A Madness Shield can be forged from madness ore by the smith Cutter, who operates Cutter's Weapons in Crucible. She can forge one shield from two pieces of madness ore. Providing a Madness Shield Matrix will cause the shield to be enchanted, as well. The quality of the shield and, if applicable, its enchantment is scaled to the Hero's level at the time when asking Cutter to make it.

Preferring to use their extensive knowledge of Magic, Mages wield a might as powerful as the sharpest blade or the deadliest mace. Mages spend many years studying schools of the arcane arts, leaving behind most other pursuits. Depending on their magical abilities for offensive and defensive power, mages are typically lacking in armor or shields and utilize limited to no physical weaponry.

Mage's Staff is a leveled, enchanted staff obtained as a reward for achieving the Apprentice rank in the Mages Guild. After completing the quest, "A Mage's Staff" and receiving the Unfinished Staff, Delmar at the Chironasium imbues the magic wood with a desired effect. After selecting the desired effect, 24 hours must pass before it can be obtained from the cupboard in the Chironasium. Nine possible enchantments, from three schools of Magicka can be chosen from. The intensity of the enchantment is gauged by the Character Level at the time of the quest's completion.
The Mage's Helmet is an enchanted chainmail helmet with a Fortify Magicka enchantment. It can be found randomly as loot.

Mage Armor denotes a perk and corresponding spells from the Alteration School of Magic in . Serving as Skyrims counterpart of the Shield spell from previous titles, Mage Armor spells boost the armor class of the caster and may be dual-casted.
Magma Armor is a Dragonknight ultimate skill in the Earthen Heart skill line in .

Majoll is a Nord who is part of the Spearhead's crew. He can initially be found in Stros M'Kai and afterwards on Betnikh. He is later found on a ship in Wayrest, working for Captain Albert Marck. He can be first met in the Screaming Mermaid, after the quest "Innocent Scoundrel" has been complete. He is standing among other admirers of Jakarn. Majoll is quite fond of Jakarn. He chose to join The Spearhead's crew on his quest for Jakarn's love, but was turned down by the infamous womanizer.

The Magicka Edge Axe is a unique axe in , it grants its wielder a 20% chance to deal 10+ damage each hit. While the enchantment may not seem too useful at first, its bonus to an already huge attack power gives it a chance of base damage up to 74, giving it a higher maximum attack power than the Shade War Axe.

It is the first type of destruction staff available to craft in Woodworking skill line. The maple destruction staff is the appropriate destruction staff for levels 1-15.
The Maple Bow is a two handed bow that appears in . It is the first type of bow available to craft in the Woodworking skill line. The maple bow is the appropriate bow for levels 1-15.

The Maple Restoration Staff is a two handed restoration staff that appears in . It is the first type of restoration staff available to craft in Woodworking skill line. The maple restoration staff is the appropriate restoration staff for levels 1-15.

The Marksman skill governs the effectiveness of using bow and arrow weapons. Higher Marksman skill results in increased damage for each attack. It is useful for taking out enemies that one might have to kill in stealth-like quests, or during combat if one is fast enough to avoid getting hit. :Governing attribute: Agility

Masque is an Imperial Priest who resides in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He wears a set of steel armor, carries a Steel Firesword, and spends his time at the Smith's shop in the city's waistworks. Masque does not offer any services and is not involved in any quests.

The Marie Elena is a pirate ship docked in the Waterfront District of Imperial City. The pirates around it will attack if an attempt to board is made, "stealing" or simply looking within the containers near the ship, or if they catch anyone on the floor or in the 'Captain's Chest' if the three aggressive pirates are dead. Either pick the lock or kill the captain in the quest "A Watery Grave" and take the captain's key.

Maro Rufus is one of two merchants at The Best Defense in the Market District of the Imperial City. Rufus specializes in light armor, while his partner Varnado focuses on heavy armor. Rufus can repair armor and has 800 to trade with.

The Mark of Dibella is a unique sapphire that Svana Far-Shield gives to the Dragonborn as a quest item during the miscellaneous quest "Caught Red Handed." Svana requests for the Dragonborn to obtain and give her three Marks of Dibella from her aunt Haelga's most recent lovers in an attempt to injure her pride.
Maryon's Staff is a unique ebony staff found inside the Telvanni Vault in Vivec. It is enchanted with three types of elemental damage.
Master's Armorer's Hammer is an item that, when used on either weapons or armor, increases the Armorer skill.

Master Kasan is a Khajiit and the former captain of The Spearhead. He was the mentor of Kaleen, whom he has now given control of his ship to. In his prime, he held many surnames, the most popular being Kasan Five-Claw or The Terror of the Seas. While he thinks highly of his pupil, he does not hesitate to point out her strong admiration for King Fahara'jad and the Daggerfall Covenant, which he thinks heavily influences her decisions and judgment.
Masord Axe-Beak is a Nord warrior residing in the city of Mournhold, Deshaan.
Master Fadalia is a Redguard residing in Leki's Blade, Hammerfell.

Mastengwe is an Altmer residing in a ship called The Prowler, in the region of Khenarthi's Roost. She can be found sitting on the floor on the ship during the quest "Cast Adrift" and will inform the Vestige about a Maormer ritual of creating a storm.

Marja's Mill is a farm found on the Gold Coast, to the north of Kvatch. During the Colovian Revolt Marja Nuccius used the workshops to repair weapons and armor and craft items. After it came to an end, she converted the workshops into a mill. The Kvatch Gladiator set can be crafted here.

He may become the personal woodworker hireling for the Vestige should they choose to allocate points into the Lumberjack Hireling skill for woodworking, once they reach the appropriate level. He will send a letter with select materials to the Vestige on a daily basis, although the items he sends may be improved with additional points into the Lumberjack Hireling skill.
Master Ahram Sesnit is a Vampire residing in the Alik'r Desert. He is known for founding Leki's Blade, before being discovered to being a vampire and fleeing.
The Master Sword is a weapon in The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition that is exclusive to the Nintendo Switch platform.

Martius Silius is an Imperial Great War hero and Imperial Legion veteran, and also the current Grand Champion of the Arena. He wears full Ebony Armor, excluding the helmet, and carries a unique sword. At the end of the final tournament match, both his unique helm and sword are awarded.

Medium Armor is a combat specialization skill in . Use of the skill allows the effective use of specific types of armor. The Medium Armor skill is governed by the endurance attribute. This skill works to balance the protection provided by heavy armor with the speed and lightness of light armor. The skill level is increased while wearing medium armor during combat. When a strike lands on a portion of the body covered in medium armor, progress towards the skill increase a percentage. When the progression of the current skill level reaches 100%, the skill level increases by 1.
A Matrix is a miscellaneous item that allows qualified smiths to enchant Amber weapons, Amber armor, Madness weapons, or Madness armor during the creation process.
Mauhul gor-Burish is an Orsimer Agent residing in Ashunartes. Should Mauhul be calmed, he can offer training in Acrobatics, Light Armor and Sneak, up to level 62.
Mazalish is a Khajiit merchant of the Baandari Clan. He sells his wares at his stall, Khaj-Walker's Market, at their caravan settled in Kozanset.
Maw of the Infernal is a Daedroth that appears in . It can be found in The Banished Cells II, and has a chance to drop a unique item, the Staff of Conflagration.

Mithas was greatest of the Dwemer blacksmiths who created the eponymous Anvil of Mithas. It is said that the anvil, together with the Hammer of Gharen, could produce the finest armor and weapons and that only the hammer was strong enough not to shatter upon the mighty enchanted anvil. When used together, they would also reveal the entrance to the dwarven mines beneath Dagoth-Ur. The Anvil had come into possession of King Casik of Ebontheart who tasked the Eternal Champion with retrieving the hammer in exchange for the mountains location, which housed the eighth and final piece of the Staff of Chaos.

A modification, also known as mod or plug-in, is a software file that changes some aspect of the game or adds new content, such as weapons, armor, or quests. Several official plug-ins exist for the Xbox 360 (see below), but modifications are overwhelmingly most common for the PC platform. Mods do not come pre-packed with the retail game. They are created by the game's fans, usually using the Elder Scrolls Construction Set for . They can be downloaded from the internet, usually for free. Bethesda also offers official studio-built mods, which may be downloaded for a small payment. Most mods are in the .esp format, and must be enabled as a Data File when the game first loads (see the 'Data Files' dialogue on the PC, as the game loads). Some mods may take the form of textures that replace those in the game, or .xml files that adjust display characteristics. Textures and .xml files do not need to be enabled as Data Files at start-up.

Texts such as the 36 Lessons of Vivec also use "spear" metaphorically to represent the genitals of Vivec and others. Vivec supposedly made the spear from his own love and turned it into a deadly weapon by utilizing a secret he "bit off" Molag Bal's spear while they were married. After attacking Molag Bal, Vivec used his new spear to kill all the thousands of offspring he had birthed with his then spouse, turning them into barren and withered bone-shapes. It was at this point that it was named Muatra.
